listings.thesis: Highest-priority alpha screen: strong AI/CPO/advanced-packaging theme plus smaller or less fully penetrated market-cap base.

priorCase.rankRationale: nLIGHT should move down because CPO, silicon photonics, optical DSPs, lasers, AEC/AOC or AI-scale connectivity is either less hidden after 74.0% YTD, less direct to CPO/HBM/package/test bottlenecks, or more exposed to cycle/valuation risk than the current rank 6 implies.
